title: World Bloom — Dear My Fellows — Episode1 Signs of Growth?

meta.Event Outline: Having trained with three famous troupes, Wonderlands×Showtime has certainly grown. While checking for any changes in their SEKAI, they hear of a problem with the tree, and are shown a world where they are each chasing their own dreams.

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI
Harbor

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: N-Noooooooo!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We failed again...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I saw this coming...
But it seems that we're still not able to reach Star Island.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We were able to get slightly closer than before, but we couldn't fight that current we encountered...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, it was like a rip-roaring tide!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But the Pegasus Special Deluxe Wonder tried super duper hard to fight it...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Seriously, we're really sticking with that name...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... Shunmeiza, Mikazukigumi and the Morinomiya Revue...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I was under the impression that we'd grown at least a little after training with such renowned troupes...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Cheer up...!
I know you've grown a ton, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I appreciate you saying that...
But that doesn't change the fact that we haven't even been able to catch a glimpse of that island.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Which means the road to Star Island is going to be a long and treacherous one.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, we may not be able to cross the sea, but this city may have undergone some changes...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I also believe that we've all grown after training with those other troupes.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, the possibility of changes occurring within SEKAI isn't zero.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I agree.
Another city might have appeared somewhere without us immediately realizing it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, does that mean we'll get to meet lots and lots more new plushies?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. That'd be lovely!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Then, why don't we try visiting the city?
The plushies there may be able to tell us something.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Agreed.
Asking around town seems like an excellent idea!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let's get off the ship and... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, it's just...
That part of the harbor seems unusually crowded.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hey, he's right!
A bunch of plushies are gathered over there! What do you think is going on?
Stop right there! Quit resisting arrest!

rows.Speaker: Monkey Plushie
rows.Line: No, you caught me...!
Alright, now you're going to tell me what you were doing to that tree over there!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wh-What's going on?
That plushie's talking like...

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Someone from the Edo period... He is even holding a jitte... Based on his attire, he must be...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A detective.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow, he even has an adorable little topknot☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Is this happening because of the detective story we did with Mikazukigumi...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's certainly a possibility. However...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They seem to be arguing about something, so why don't we try talking to them for a bit?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see... You were chasing after our monkey here because you thought he was doing something to the tree by that ship.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But that was all a big misunderstanding?

rows.Speaker: Monkey Plushie
rows.Line:
*Nod*
That tree looked different from usual, so I was just worried...

rows.Speaker: Detective Plushie
rows.Line:
I'm sorry...
I ended up chasing you because I'd convinced myself that you were the culprit.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, what do you mean about the tree looking different? Can you tell us more?

rows.Speaker: Detective Plushie
rows.Line: It looked covered in black and rock hard!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Covered in black... And rock hard...?

rows.Speaker: Detective Plushie
rows.Line:
It'll be faster just to show you...
Come with me, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, let's go!
se_walk_women_001_4

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's become black all over...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Wh-Wh-Wh-What happened...?!
All the leaves and branches are wilted!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
And these black flecks...
They look like fragments of some kind.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, not only that...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They sort of resemble fragments of feelings.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, now that you mention it, they kind of do... But they also seem a little different...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hey, Rui, what do you think we should do about the tree turning all black...?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right.
Rui's on that committee that takes care of plants!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Tell us what to do!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If a plant's roots aren't doing so well, one might adjust the amount of moisture in the soil... But this appears to be a different situation entirely.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm not sure if what I know applies to plants in SEKAI, but let's take a closer look and...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wait, Rui, you shouldn't touch it...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Whoa!!
What's happening?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh no!
Y-You guys!
